text:
Anya Patel: Quick flag — after the GA4 tag push last night our inbound dashboard (Pulseboard) shows a ~28% drop in Ads -> Signup conversion for paid channels. Can we triage before the weekly KPI review? https://pulseboard.internal/redwood/inbound
Kevin Liu: saw that. looks like a parameter mismatch to me. quick check: hubspot ingestion logs show missing click_id for a subset of google campaigns.
Sophie Tran: adding a triage doc in Notion and will drop the immediate checks there. I'll run a quick SQL to count null gclid by campaign.
growth-bot: deploy: ga4-tagging-v3 rolled out by Matthew Reed at 2350013700 (detected 2350013758)
Matthew Reed: I pushed v3 last night to add enhanced_event_fields. If it's breaking downstream we can patch or roll back, but need a fast diagnosis.
Anya Patel: can someone run a quick cohort compare (last 7d vs prior 7d) for leads attributed to paid search? we want to know if this is a measurement gap or real drop.
Kevin Liu: ran a quick probe, SQL snippet I used:
```
SELECT campaign, COUNT(*) AS leads_missing_gclid
FROM analytics.events
WHERE source = 'google' AND gclid IS NULL
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-14' AND '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY campaign
ORDER BY leads_missing_gclid DESC;
```
Result: 742 leads missing gclid, ~68% from campaign param set "summer-lift-22" and a handful of UTM variants.
Sophie Tran: interesting — devops reported Google changed click param name for a subset of publishers (gclsrc/gclid rename). It seems our tag v3 didn't map the alternate param. Plan: 1) quick ETL mapping patch to populate gclid from gclsrc when present 2) backfill last 7 days where possible 3) add a note on the KPI board that these days are affected. Assignments: Kevin -> ETL patch, Matthew -> monitor rollback risk, Anya -> comms to Sales Ops and KPI owners.
Matthew Reed: I can hotfix the tag config to include alt param mapping and patch GTM within the hour. rolling back is heavier and might remove other fixes, so prefer mapping first.
Anya Patel: thanks. if we can get a backfill and patch by EOD we should be safe for the weekly review; otherwise we'll annotate the KPI card to avoid false alarms. :thumbsup:
Kevin Liu: pinging infra for ETL window and will open a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/etl/pull/487
Sophie Tran: I'll update the Notion triage doc with timeline + add a temporary chart on Pulseboard showing 'corrected' vs 'raw' so PMs see the delta.
growth-bot: reminder: Weekly KPI review scheduled 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC — channel #marketing
Anya Patel: leaving this here — will post an update once the backfill completes. If anything blocks the EOD plan I'll call for a short huddle.
Kevin Liu: noted, will report back by 1800 UTC with PR and runbook steps.
